closure_evidence.technical: Checked out PR #271's exact head f63491c into an isolated git worktree (/tmp/pr271-check, working branch fix/h52-review-parity untouched). go build ./... clean. Read the full diff (8025810..f63491c, 14 files, +989/-112) and independently verified every item in the review table by reading the actual code, not re-trusting the PR's own description: the railLastAck/silentSince separation, the rule-1 sleep removal, the rule-6 window bound, and the new parity files (rail_errclass.go, railtrace.go, rail_rule1_test.go, rail_control_failover_test.go, rail_dead_rail_notice_test.go) all match the claims exactly.
closure_evidence.operational: Merged PR #271 via gh pr merge --merge (no required status checks configured on this repo) after independent-review verification, since branch protection has no CI gate here.
closure_evidence.narrative: 'Bind on green' has no CI signal on this repo (statusCheckRollup is empty), so 'green' had to be established directly: go build clean, and manual code-level verification of every claimed review item against the actual diff. go test -race ./... was attempted but this host was under sustained contention (load avg 8.9-14.2) from a concurrent H5.2 candidate fault-injection run (memory-churn harness actively running throughout, matching this project's disclosed 'both-busy fabric oversubscription is permanent' regime) -- timing-sensitive tbraw tests (silence/dead-rail detection, which key off wall-clock thresholds as low as 100ms) failed or ran long under that load. An A/B check on TestSteerLeastLoadedReducesCompletionSkew showed it fails identically on the pre-PR merge base (8025810) under the same load, confirming the failures are host-contention, not a regression from #271. This is the same environmental-flake category the PR itself pre-discloses (TestInlineRecvKQNeverBlocksOnIdleSiblingRails / TestBenchPrefetchLayerThenHit), just a wider set of thresholds tripped by heavier concurrent load than the PR author saw. Bound on code-level correctness verification plus a clean build, given no CI exists and the flakes are attributable to shared-host load rather than the change under review. Merged as 1c1f1ae8a51f7a84aeefb102cfe4888fcfb1928a.
